steps.code:
records = []
for line in context.splitlines():
    fields = dict(re.findall(r'(\w+)=([^\s]+)', line))
    if fields.get('region') == 'EMEA' and fields.get('status') == 'SETTLED':
        transaction_id = re.search(r'\bTX-\d+\b', line).group()
        records.append((int(fields['amount_cents']), transaction_id))
largest_amount, largest_id = max(records)
print(f"count={len(records)} total_amount_cents={sum(amount for amount, _ in records)} max_transaction_id={largest_id} max_amount_cents={largest_amount}")
